detailed_descriptions_html.en:
"Slot or not" is a deck-building turn-based slot machine battling adventure.

The game perfects the formula of mashing up a deck-builder RPG like Slay the Spire with a Balatro-like abundance of items to build your "hand" and wild synergies to discover. The slot machine battle mechanics, where you toss your gear into the drawing pool and attack/defend based on the outcome gives it that special chance-game vibe, for the gambler inside us all (but with no actual gambling!).

🎲 Rogue-like game generation for near endless playthrough variance
🎒 40+ playable items you can carry in your bag and spin in your slot machine for 
🥕 ️49 game-changing trinkets to spice things and give you more build flexibility
👹 30+ tricky enemies waiting for you at every node of the branching level maps
👤 Random encounters, special events, and helpful (?) NPCs you'll meet on your way
🎨 Original art and story by a professional comic book artist. No AI chicanery!
🎵 Upbeat, original music score helping you immerse yourself in the colorful game world
🎰 Slots without gambling (B-bye addiction!!!)
♾️ Endless replayability - finishing a run is just an invitation to start another one!

Spin it to win it NOW!
